filename: A review of recent advances in urban flood research.pdf
title: A review of recent advances in urban flood research
processes: storm surge and sea level rise interaction
testbed_rationale: This paper is a review article and does not generate or provide any original dataset or benchmark.
pain_points: Lack of detailed and accessible underground sewer network and drainage infrastructure data (due to age or security concerns)
High computational cost and long runtimes of 2D/shallow water equation hydraulic models
Inadequate spatial resolution in rain gauge networks for urban catchments
AI/ML models are constrained by limited availability of long, accurate historical training records, especially in simulating unprecedented extreme events
Mapped flood inundation observations are sparse in urban areas
extraction_notes: The paper explicitly states under Data availability: 'No data was used for the research described in the article.' Hence, no datasets are listed. First author Candace Agonafir is affiliated with LEAP (Learning the Earth with Artificial Intelligence and Physics).
